offers_products.reason: Sells furniture and large-parcel goods (own-brand products, e.g., Noble House) to resellers via the marketplace, the larger revenue part.

offers_services.reason: Marketplace platform plus logistics, drop shipping, last-mile delivery and 3PL services for suppliers and resellers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are wholesale resellers, retailers and suppliers on the B2B marketplace; end consumers receive deliveries but don't buy from it.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Resellers, retailers, distributors, brands and suppliers are the marketplace's buyers and sellers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Resellers repeatedly order furniture and large goods through the marketplace; repeat buyers drive most sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Furniture and large goods are discretionary; housing-linked demand falls in downturns and resellers can cut orders.

big_ticket.reason: Resellers place frequent wholesale orders of furniture items, though individual items are bulky; typical orders are modest and repeated.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from goods, marketplace technology and warehouse/logistics network, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly small and mid-sized online resellers and retailers rather than large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates a global network of owned and leased warehouses and logistics across the U.S., Europe, Canada and Japan, needing ongoing investment.

notes: Reseller size and the product versus service revenue split come from general knowledge, not the website text.
